scripts.native:build:tsgolint: cd native/tsgolint-effect-fork && GOCACHE=${GOCACHE:-/tmp/go-build-cache} GOTMPDIR=${GOTMPDIR:-/tmp} go build -o tsgolint ./cmd/tsgolint
scripts.native:build:oxlint: cd native/oxc-oxlint-effect-fork && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:/opt/data/dev-home/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo build -p oxlint --release --features allocator
scripts.publish:stage: pnpm build && pnpm native:stage && vp pm stage publish -r --filter './packages/*' --access public --provenance -- --no-git-checks
scripts.publish:stage:dry-run: pnpm build && pnpm native:stage && vp pm stage publish -r --filter './packages/*' --access public --provenance --dry-run -- --no-git-checks
